## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New or changed code in `src/lib` has tests (including a failure half way for anything that changes files)
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot attached, controls are big and labelled, tried in the packaged app on a *copy* of a pack
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No game files, no other people's clothing, no personal paths or e-mail addresses in the diff
- [ ] I am happy for this to be released under GPL-3.0-or-later
